candidate_relations.reason: The record supports rheumatoid meningitis through high-titer cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, rheumatoid-directed therapy, leptomeningeal inflammation, and compatible biopsy findings; no evidence establishes Sjögren syndrome.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different systemic autoimmune disease with nonspecific CNS involvement

candidate_relations.reason: Although meningeal inflammation is present, biopsy stains and infectious testing are negative, and the clinicopathologic pattern supports rheumatoid rather than infectious meningitis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Meningitis with an incompatible infectious etiology

candidate_relations.reason: The record lacks systemic sarcoidosis evidence, including chest CT pathology, and instead supports rheumatoid meningitis; multinucleated giant cells alone do not establish neurosarcoidosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct granulomatous inflammatory disorder of the nervous system
